extracted.name: Whole grain fusilli pasta with tomato basil sauce
extracted.description: A healthier choice compare to normal 🍝 pasta.
ingredient_lines: 200 g fusilli pasta whole grain or your choice of pasta
instruction_lines: In a big pot bring water to a boil and add the pasta with some salt cook to your preference.
Chop the onion and the garlic. And put them in a sauce pan with the oil and sauté them
Now add salt pepper all spice water sugar Crashed tomatoes basil oregano and bring to a boil and cook till sauce reduce to your preference.
You can top with some parmigiana or Greek mizithra. Kali orexi. Enjoy.
